newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best downgrades Westchester Specialty Group.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best downgrades Westchester Specialty Group.

text.p: A.M. Best said it had lowered the rating on Westchester Specialty Group Cos to "A-" (Excellent) from "A".

The rating agency said the downgrade applies to Westchester Fire Insurance Co and its two reinsured affiliates. It said the action reflects the group's poor calendar-year operating performance, which was driven by substantial adverse reserve development and the group's diminished casualty umbrella market presence.

Best said that despite significantly boosting its casualty reserves in 1995, the group continues to suffer from unusually high loss-reserve development on its historical book. During the second quarter of 1997, the group will record $200 million of additional statutory charges for reserve strengthening and uncollectible reinsurance.

Despite this rating action, Best said Westchester's "Excellent" rating reflects the group's rebalanced excess book, improving accident-year results, solid capitalization, disciplined underwriting approach and strong broker relations.
